integrity: Explicit proof, finite reproducibility checks, and documented close-prior implication assessment; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the fixed ternary digit set {0,1,5}; essential rather than arbitrary representative topological boundary. A related Pell growth factor for maximal integer blocks was established in Tangjai (2020); only the ambiguity-prefix law and geometric boundary classification are asserted here. General digit sets and Hausdorff measure not evaluated. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Pell-growth boundary dimension of the ternary nonstandard digit scaling set
